invariants.claim: Normal return requires prizeToken to have positive code length at validation.
Normal return excludes factory, quote token, wrapper, implementation and current local registered raffles from prizeToken; sponsorRecipient additionally must be nonzero and differ from prizeToken.
Normal return requires a decoded true ERC-721 supportsInterface response; caught call failures and decoded false reject.
Normal return requires reserveEntries in [1, type(uint128).max].
The helper writes no persistent state and emits no events; its sole external interaction is the typed view interface query.

assumptions.claim: The prize address contains deployed code before the interface query (RaffleFactory.sol:L155, L172).
assumptions.establishedBy: RaffleFactory._requireContract, RaffleFactory.sol:L183-L185, on every normal return

assumptions.claim: A true supportsInterface response corresponds to actual standards-compliant ERC-721 behavior (RaffleFactory.sol:L172-L177; IERC165.sol:L17-L24).
The registry used for address exclusion represents this factory's registered clones (RaffleFactory.sol:L159, L166).
assumptions.establishedBy: RaffleFactory.createRaffle sets isRaffle[raffle] = true at RaffleFactory.sol:L123-L125 after clone creation at L106

assumptions.claim: Whole-creation timing and escrow preconditions are enforced outside this helper (RaffleFactory.sol:L154-L179).
assumptions.establishedBy: RaffleFactory.createRaffle timing checks at L99-L104 and post-transfer owner/status checks at L127-L134; token-reported ownership remains dependent on the arbitrary prize implementation

calls.propagates: At RaffleFactory.sol:L155, depends on L183-L185: zero code length reverts NotContract; every successful path establishes positive code length and nothing about interface or ownership behavior.

RaffleFactory.sol:L172 sends the ERC-721 interface ID without value via the external view signature (IERC165.sol:L24). Decoded true permits progress, decoded false and caught failures reject (L173-L177). Concrete implementation unavailable; truthful standard compliance is not established by the boolean.

callers: RaffleFactory.createRaffle, RaffleFactory.sol:L97-L98; validation precedes timing checks, count increment, cloning and escrow (L99-L134).
sharedState: Reads immutable quoteToken, vrfWrapper, raffleImplementation initialized at RaffleFactory.sol:L85-L91; reads isRaffle membership at L159/L166, written by createRaffle at L125.
openQuestions: unclear; need to inspect the concrete sponsor-selected prize implementation to determine whether its supportsInterface assertion matches ERC-721 transfer and ownership behavior (RaffleFactory.sol:L172; IERC165.sol:L24).
